unresolved_design_decisions: Final scalar normalization parameters and fit source for every numeric feature.
Stable categorical vocabularies and catalog content/order fingerprints for champions, traits, items, components and recipes.
Exact embedding dimensions and entity encoder output widths.
Whether board spatial encoder uses a hex-aware representation; native 4x7 slot geometry is not accepted as canonical hex semantics without proof.
Exact Critic summaries, if any, derived from Actor-specific item/recipe compatibility facts.
Exact tensor dtype, axes, batch/sequence dimensions, padding/truncation and overflow policy for variable entity sets.
Formula identity and calibration for estimated board power, relative power, positioning, unit roles, item/recipe fit and anchor values.
